rules: Use clear hierarchy with proper spacing
Group related elements logically
Use 8px spacing scale for consistency
Ensure visual balance between sections
Keep layouts responsive and grid-aligned
Use a consistent color palette with 1 primary, 1 secondary, and 1 accent color
High contrast for text vs background
Avoid overly bright or saturated colors unless necessary
Use neutral backgrounds for readability
Use max 2 font families
Headings should be bold and large
Body text should be 14–18px for readability
Maintain consistent line heights and spacing
Buttons must have clear call-to-action text
Forms should be minimal with clear labels
Use icons to improve clarity but sparingly
Cards should use subtle shadows and rounded corners
Use high-quality images
Apply consistent border radius if used
Avoid cluttering with too many visuals
Ensure text is readable (minimum 4.5:1 contrast)
Buttons and clickable items must be large enough
Avoid excessive animations
